messages:
Jordan: heads-up  PR #489 landed a new section on union types + structured output. I flagged a couple of real-world edge cases we should document: arrays vs single-object returns, explicit null for tool payloads, and union-discriminators. Can someone take the docs polish?
Priya: I can run through the text. For union discriminators, do we want to recommend explicit `type` fields in schemas, or rely on shape-based matching?
Jordan: prefer recommending an explicit `type` discriminator in examples, but show a short fallback paragraph for shape-matching (since many models don't emit `type`). Keep examples < 8 lines.
Lin: I'll add two tiny examples: (1) `items: [] | {id: string}` array-or-object wrap shim, (2) nullable `result` with metadata. Also will add a Go SDK snippet for structured parsing since we have few Go examples.
Priya: thanks. For the array fallback, suggest `ensureSlice()` helper in the snippet and show safe iteration.
Lin: draft Go snippet:
```go
res, err := client.StructuredParse(ctx, respBody, schema)
if err != nil {
  // fallback: log and surface simpleText
}
items := EnsureSlice(res.Value.Items)
for _, it := range items {
  // process
}
```
Lin: note: `EnsureSlice` is a tiny helper we show in the examples folder. Should we commit it to examples/util.go?
Jordan: yes, add it to examples/ and reference it. Also add a 1-line JS example showing `.structuredParse()` discriminated result handling.
Priya: small wording nit in the heading: change "Union falling back" -> "Union fallback patterns". I'll push that grammar fix.
ci-bot: CI status: docs build passed for PR #489 (checks: lint, link-check, preview).
Jordan: nice. Two more asks: (A) add a short note under "guardrails" about adding a lenient JSON reformat step (run the model's text through `tryParseJSON()` and if still bad, ask for corrected JSON with a 2nd prompt + rate-limit); (B) fix the internal-only link to the eval harness (replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/simple-harness).
Priya: I'll update the guardrails paragraph and replace the link. Also adding a pytest example that asserts parse output for the nullable case: `assert parsed['result'] is None or isinstance(parsed['result'], dict)` so it's obvious.
Lin: pushed examples: examples/go/parse_fallback.go, examples/util.go, examples/py/test_nullable.py, examples/js/ensureArray.js
Jordan: great. Who's merging after the link-fix + small grammar patch?
Priya: I can merge once ci-bot is green and docs-bot preview looks correct.
docs-bot: preview updated for PR #489  changed files: docs/structured-output-unions.md, examples/go/parse_fallback.go, examples/util.go, examples/py/test_nullable.py, examples/js/ensureArray.js
Jordan: thanks all. After merge, I'll open a tiny follow-up to add an anchor from the function-calling guide to the union examples. :rocket:
